new_learnings.text: Entry regime gate (breadth 0.24:1, 0/3 indices green, 55 limit-downs) correctly prevented deploying capital into a -4% to -8% single-session drawdown. This is the single most valuable V2 defense — V1 would have found reasons to buy and lost 5-10% today.
new_learnings.mechanism: When breadth collapses below 0.5:1 with multiple indices deeply red and limit-downs exceeding 30, individual stock fundamentals become irrelevant — sector gravity and forced deleveraging dominate all names. The regime gate forces the critical question 'should I buy anything?' before evaluating any single name.

new_learnings.text: IV Rank hit 100th percentile across all 9 ETF proxies simultaneously (科创50 IV=0.7585, 创业板 IV=0.519, 500ETF IV=0.365). This is the most extreme vol event in 252-day lookback. Historical precedent: previous IV-100 events marked panic bottoms but timing ranged days-to-weeks. Do NOT front-run — wait for breadth to recover above 1.5:1 before deploying.
new_learnings.mechanism: Extreme IV means options market is pricing disaster-level outcomes. The path from 'priced for disaster' to 'actually recovering' can involve further drawdowns. The regime gate captures this: breadth must recover first, then evaluate entries.

new_learnings.text: Sector gravity confirmed during panic: 通信设备 -8.32% vs 电力 +2.34% — 10.66% spread. All strategy pool stocks in tech/growth sectors are getting crushed regardless of individual RPS or fundamentals. Confirms h019: bottom-list sectors are hard no-buy zones.
new_learnings.mechanism: During panic de-risking events, sector-level forced selling (redemptions, margin calls, stop-loss cascades) overwhelms individual stock fundamentals. Stocks move with their sector beta regardless of company quality.

new_learnings.text: Strategy pool is heavily skewed toward tech/growth (semiconductor, pharma, chemicals, electronics). In a defensive rotation like today, zero pool stocks overlap with hot sectors (电力, 银行, 炼化). Consider expanding pool to include defensive/energy names for regime diversification.
new_learnings.mechanism: The cheesefortune_intersection pool naturally selects growth/momentum names. When growth rotates out, the pool becomes entirely uninvestable. A complementary defensive pool (or broader sector coverage) would give the system more options during risk-off regimes.
